source_note: Anthropic's workflow advice is explore, plan, then code, and plan mode is the built-in way to do it; Boris Cherny says most of his sessions start in plan mode. With: step 1 is the task in --permission-mode plan with the session kept, step 2 resumes it with the fixed line 'The plan is approved. Implement it now.' in acceptEdits. Plan approval is simulated by that text, as a headless run can't click Approve. Without: the standard single call in acceptEdits. Time, cost, turns and tokens are summed over both steps; the 20-minute cap covers both. Task set and model as every day since 15 Sep: t1, t2, t3, h2 on Haiku 4.5, 3 runs per task per side.

turns.prompt: The plan is approved. Implement it now.
